summary: This is an advisory question asking whether more public benches should be added downtown. The stated reason is to bring more business to the area. If it passes, it only records what residents want. Nothing happens automatically. No benches are ordered, and no money is set aside by this vote alone. Any actual bench installation would need a separate decision that the text does not describe.

changes.before: Residents' views on adding more downtown benches are not formally recorded.
changes.after: The vote records whether residents want more public benches downtown. No benches are added automatically.
